releases.displayName: WITAJCIE! POLISH LANGUAGE SUPPORT IS HERE

items.text: Hi UNO™ players!
We're Snap Finger Click, the small independent team of party game developers working on UNO™.

We are always looking at the community to see how we can make the game more accessible and enjoyable for everyone. We know that Polish speakers make up a huge, passionate part of our player base, and we want to make sure you feel right at home.
So, today, we are incredibly excited to announce that official Polish language support has arrived in UNO™!

You can now navigate the menus, read card descriptions, and set up your lobbies entirely in Polish. To switch your language, simply head into the Options menu and select Polish from the language settings.
🔧 TECH UPDATES
Alongside the new language support, we’ve also rolled out a fresh batch of bug fixes and polish to keep your game running smoothly. Here are a few of the highlights of what we fixed in today's patch:
Resolved a confusing visual bug where the game would occasionally tell players to draw "+0" cards.
Ensured that custom boards display correctly for everyone when you join a private online lobby.
Active house rules will now consistently and correctly appear on-screen in online lobbies.
Eliminated several rare crash bugs behind the scenes to keep your UNO™ sessions running as smoothly as possible.
Fixed a crash that could occasionally interrupt your game when joining The Call of Yara or Fenyx's Quest matches.
Resolved a soft-lock that could happen if a player left a Party! Mania DLC online match in the middle of a Wild Pile Up event.
Plus multiple other minor bug fixes and stability improvements to keep things running smoothly.
💬 WHAT’S NEXT

We are really grateful for our growing global community. Dziękujemy za grę! Let us know what you think of the new translation, and if you run into any issues, come chat with our team directly in the Community Discord:
discord.gg/snapfingerclick
Snap Finger Click
Hi UNO™ Players,
We are back with another update. Following our previous ‘tech patches’ on November 5th and November 20th, we are releasing Tech Patch #3 today.

We want to be transparent with you: we know the game still hasn't been where it needs to be. At Snap Finger Click we read your reviews, forum posts, and your Discord messages. We know that the crashes, input bugs, and freezes have been frustrating, and we are working flat out to fix them.
This patch is a big one. We have focused heavily on "Soft Locks" (where the game gets stuck mid-match), Crashes, and Input Issues (mouse/touch not responding).

notes.title: Here is what we fixed in this update

items.text: 🛑 Crashes & Freezes (Stability)
Online: Fixed an issue where the game could display +0 and desync.
UNO Show ‘em No Mercy™ DLC: Fixed a soft lock where the game would get stuck if a player held a Reverse card of the same color after receiving a +4/+6/+10 penalty.
Skip n’ Flip: Fixed an issue where the game could desync or get stuck after declining a skipped +4 Wild card challenge.
UNO Valhalla™ DLC: Fixed a crash that occurred during online gameplay with a full lobby.
Online: Fixed a crash that happened randomly and where players were presented with an incorrect “Connection Time Out” error message.
AI: Fixed an issue where an AI player could become stuck after a draw card was played.
🎮 Controls & Gameplay
Mouse Input: Fixed a frustrating bug where the mouse would stop working if the only playable cards in your hand were ones you just drew.
1) Fixed an issue where players couldn't stack cards when playing the UNO Valhalla™ DLC.
2) Fixed an issue preventing players from stacking a +2 card via touch input.
3) Fixed an issue preventing mouse users from drawing a card if they had the option to stack a +4 or +2.
4) Fixed an issue where stacking cards weren’t highlighted when it was the player’s turn.
Skip n' Flip Logic: Fixed a bug where players were incorrectly given "Challenge/Decline" options for Skip/Reverse cards if they had previously been hit by a +4.
Skipping: Fixed an issue where a player’s turn could be skipped for no reason.
End Results: Fixed an issue where multiple players would be listed as being in 1st place on the end of match screen.
🚫 Exploit Fixes
The "Timer Skip" Exploit: Fixed an issue where players could avoid drawing cards from a +2 or +4 by remaining inactive until the timer ran out.
Infinite Coins: Fixed an exploit where coins were awarded continuously during the end-game screen.
🎨 Visuals & Audio
Theme Music: Fixed the "Winter Theme" and "Alien World" music tracks not playing correctly in MyDesign.
UNO Valhalla™ DLC Theme: Fixed a visual bug where the screen hue would turn green during matches.
Store: Fixed misaligned borders on some of the cards in the Store.
Player Portraits: Fixed a bug where your player portrait would briefly glitch into another player's portrait.
The Cut-out Island board: Fixed a visual bug where the board looked saturated and had overlapping elements.
What We Are Working on Next

This patch tackles multiple player-reported bugs, and we’re incredibly grateful to all the players who have helped us isolate these issues. We are a small, independent team, but we are fully committed to getting this right.
If you run into new issues after this patch, please tell us. The best place to help us is our Community Discord (discord.gg/snapfingerclick), where you can speak to us directly.
Snap Finger Click
Hi UNO™ Players,

We want to start by addressing the state of the game directly. We know that since our update on October 21st, the game’s stability has not been good enough. Many of you are experiencing crashes and disconnects, and we understand that this is incredibly frustrating. This isn't the experience you should be having, and for that, we are sorry.
We are Snap Finger Click, a small independent studio that took over development of UNO™ last year. We love this game as much as you do, and we are working urgently to get it back into great shape.
● Stability: Two weeks ago, we released our first ‘Tech Patch,’ which significantly reduced crash rates.

● Store & Items (The New Update): Yesterday we released Tech Patch #2. This fixes the issue where some players saw empty store pages. We want to assure you that no items were lost - this was a display error. After installing this patch, the store will work as normal, and you will have full access to your unlocked items.
We know there are still reports of other issues. Some of these are complex and only affect specific players, which makes them harder to pin down, but we aren't stopping here.

If you are seeing consistent issues, please help us fix them faster by sharing details in our community Discord (discord.gg/snapfingerclick). This helps our dev team investigate and squash these bugs much faster.
Thank you for hanging in there with us. We genuinely appreciate your patience.
Snap Finger Click

Hi UNO players! We're Snap Finger Click, a small independent studio that specialises in party games. We’ve previously worked with Ubisoft on Family Feud® and Trivial Pursuit Live! 2, and we took over the development of UNO™ last year. We’ve already delivered the UNO Party! Mania™ and UNO Show ‘Em No Mercy DLCs to you, a Twitch Extension, a Happy Hour feature to give you free access to the game’s DLC, bug fixes ❤️‍🔥, and more.

We know that since the 10/21 update, the game's stability hasn't been good enough. Many of you are experiencing crashes and disconnects, and we want to be direct: this is frustrating and not the experience you should be having. We are sorry for that.
Today, we have launched a new update, which contains a series of high-priority fixes.
Here is an overview of the improvements in this first Tech Patch:
Addressed multiple crash bugs.
Fixed a bug where your Ubisoft Connect avatar would appear blue-tinted and mirrored.
Ensured all players receive their starting value of 500 coins.

Addressed an issue where players could be dropped into an eliminated player's position in the Show ‘Em No Mercy DLC and be left unable to play. This may still occur in rare cases, but it should be significantly less likely. We are continuing to work on a complete fix for this.
Fixed an issue where joining an online Classic game could incorrectly put you into a DLC game, and vice versa.
Thanks for hanging in there with us. We genuinely appreciate your patience and feedback while we work hard to get UNO back into great shape. 🙏
– Snap Finger Click
We're Snap Finger Click, a small independent team of party game developers. We’ve
previously worked with Ubisoft on Family Feud® and Trivial Pursuit Live! 2, and we
took over the development of UNO™ earlier this year. We’ve already delivered the UNO
Party! Mania™ DLC to you, a Twitch Extension, a Happy Hour feature to give you free
access to the game’s DLC, bug fixes ❤️‍🔥, and more.
When we started on the game, one of the first things we did was to carefully look at
the existing reviews and other areas where you, as a player, leave feedback (hello
Reddit 👋). We’re looking into some of the most frequently-mentioned topics you’d like
to see addressed, and what features you’d like to see. A common point of feedback has
been about the online multiplayer mode of the game. We’re pleased to say that, with
this new update, your online multiplayer experience should be significantly smoother
(more on this below).
We know UNO™ is hugely popular on Twitch, so for all you streamers we’ve added a
new dedicated Twitch mode. The Chat Chaos mode is a different way to experience
Twitch interactive features in UNO™, using the chat for viewers to type in commands.
In this mode, the game reads in the text from the viewer chat. Viewers are invited to
vote on different disruptions that their host will have to face. Will they vote to flip the
host's hand of cards around? Will they ban red cards from play? Or our personal
favourite, Twitch Plays UNO™ where the viewers take over the game! And of course,
you can also ask your favourite Twitch streamer to check out this mode and see how
you can bring chaos to their game. The Twitch Chat Chaos mode is in addition to the
UNO™ Twitch Extension that was launched earlier this year.
With the holiday season in full swing, we thought it would be nice to give players a
special bonus. You’ll notice two brand new card decks: Winter Flora and Winter
Solstice. We’ve also added some festive avatar frames: the lively Winter Fun, and the
super cute Hotspring Hideaway. And what’s more, we’ve composed a retro holiday
soundtrack, “Deck the Halls with Synths”. This music harks back to the golden era of
classic 80s winter hits and is sure to give you a nostalgic holiday season! You can
unlock all the new themed content for free by playing UNO™.
As with every UNO™ update, we also bring you bug fixes, polish, and general
improvements to give you a smoother UNO™ experience. We’re always listening to
your feedback and suggestions, and making improvements to UNO™ is an ongoing
area of focus for us, so if you find an issue with the game, please get in touch with
Ubisoft Support and provide them with as much detail as possible.
We have an exciting 2025 ahead of us for UNO™, but in the meantime, we’d love for
you to check out this new update!

notes.title: ✨ Improvements have been made to the online multiplayer mode

items.text: • Bugs related to the syncing between players have been fixed.
• The game now auto-starts when the lobby is full.
• Updates have been made to the matchmaking algorithm to prioritise joining games
with 1 or 2 players.
• We've increased the 'thinking time' during an online game to allow for Twitch voting.
• Online games can now be started without any human opponents in the lobby.
• In Chat Chaos you can link UNO™ with your Twitch account to play a special game
mode with Twitch viewers. Viewers can vote via the Twitch chat for different
disruptions to inflict upon their host.
• 2 new free card decks: Winter Flora and Winter Solstice
• 2 new free avatar frames: Winter Fun and Hotspring Hideaway
• 1 new free soundtrack: Deck the Halls with Synths
This new update also brings you other bug fixes, below are a few of the highlights:
● Fixed bugs that could cause the game to crash.
● Fixed bugs that could impact online gameplay.
● Fixed an issue where the game could crash if a player would quit a match after
playing the skip card in local play.
● Fixed an issue where the game could get stuck in online multiplayer if a player
would leave the sessions after playing the Point Taken Card.
● Fixed an issue reported by players where two sound effects would play after
selecting an avatar.
● Fixed overlapping issues that could occur in the multiplayer game lobby.
● Fixed an issue where the "Shout, let it out loud" Ubisoft Connect Challenge
would not get updated, even after completing the required criteria.
● Players reported that no music was playing during the game credits anymore.
This has now been resolved.
● Fixed an issue where tutorial text could overlap the design in Add-Ons matches.
● Fixed an issue where the game could get stuck on the loading page when
accessing the Ubisoft Connect overlay in offline mode.
● Fixed an issue in the online multiplayer mode where the host would sometimes
receive a Connection Time-Out error after starting an online session with a full
lobby, whilst playing DLC.
● UNO Party! Mania™ DLC: Fixed an issue where the game could get stuck after
playing the Wild Pile Up card in an online session.
● UNO The Call of Yara™ DLC: Fixed an issue where the game could crash when a
player plays a card while Philly Barzaga's service is called.
● UNO Rayman Theme™ DLC: Fixed an issue where the pile could get corrupted,
this would happen if one of the players would hide their cards after using
"Escape" and then gets served with a Draw +2 card.
Snap Finger Click

items.text: Updating the installer process
Dear Players,

Many players have been experiencing crash issues while trying to play UNO online with Bit Defender anti-virus. We have identified the issue and are working with the Bit Defender team to fix it. This fix should be available before the end of March via an updated of BitDefender software. In the meantime, players can create an exception for UNO in the Active Threat Control by following directions at the link below. We will provide another update when the software update is available. This includes both Free and Paid versions of Bitdefender 2017.
Uno Dev Team

releases.displayName: Known issues and how to prevent them

items.text: Hello UNO players!

We are sorry hearing that some of our players have issues with playing UNO on PC. The dev. team is currently investigating and fixing the issues our players have reported to us. In the meantime, you can find more information on the most know issues below and how to prevent them.
If you have encountered any issues yourself, please let us know by reporting them to our support team:

notes.title: 1. Game crashes when creating or joining online match

items.text: Please disable any anti-virus software and re-launch the game. We have found Bit Defender anti-virus causes a crash every time, please disable or if necessary, uninstall your anti-virus software if you are experiencing this crash. This issue may also be resolved by uninstalling and re-installing the game. If the issue is not resolved by these steps, please contact UNO Support at Support@Ubisoft.com
2. Start Match Button Disappears when player joins/3. Friends can’t connect to match/4. No Network Message when trying to get Online:

This is caused by a player not connecting with the host properly (Usually due to NAT setting). You can modify your Router settings to create an Open NAT setup. More information on how to do this is on the UNO Support site.
5. Winter Theme doesn’t appear in store or can’t be loaded in game:
The Winter Theme isn’t published correctly on Uplay, we are trying to fix this ASAP. If players are encountering this on the Steam version, please contact UNO Support at Support@Ubisoft.com

notes.title: 6. Game crashes or hangs on disconnect
